ns2:section.sectionText: Students must enroll in lecture section (AL1) and lab section AB1 (36643) to complete registration in this course. Non-LIS graduate students and juniors and seniors must have permission of instructor to enroll (mwolske@illinois.edu). Required travel at mid-semester and near end of semester. Syllabus will have course and travel details. A non-waived course fee will be assessed to the tuition and fees bill.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s).
